# Threat Model — Meus Exames / Minha Saúde API (`/workspace/server`)

## Overview
REST API (Express 5 + Prisma 6 + PostgreSQL) for a Brazilian **health app** ("Meus Exames / Minha Saúde", janocaminho.com.br) that stores medical exams, lab results, prescriptions, mental-health screenings (PHQ-9/GAD-7), measurements, and AI-generated health analyses. **LGPD applies — health data is "sensitive personal data" (Art. 5, II)**, so confidentiality findings carry elevated legal/business impact.

- **Tenancy model**: multi-tenant **by user** — every `Patient` row has `ownerId` (User). Doctors have a separate account type (`type:'doctor'` JWT), blocked from patient area by `requireAuth`.
- **Roles**: `OWNER` (patient app user, default), `ADMIN` (backoffice), doctor accounts.
- **PII at rest**: CPF encrypted (`cpfEncrypted`+IV, `cpfHash`, masked last-4), patient photos (facial), exam PDFs/images, clinical narratives.
- **Payments**: Mercado Pago + OpenPix + Asaas (PIX/card); subscription approval via public webhooks.
- **Repo hygiene signals** (to be verified): real `.env` and a Firebase service-account JSON (`janocaminho-...-firebase-adminsdk-...json`) sit at repo root.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions
1. **Unauthenticated internet → public surface**: `/api/auth/*` (register/login/OTP/google), `/api/public/*` (decifre, lead, v1 API, shared reports w/ PIN), `/api/webhooks/{openpix,asaas}`, `/api/health`, `/api/app/version`, `/api/app-config`, `/api/docs` (swagger), `/api/patients/:id/photo` (any valid JWT via `?t=`), `/api/labs`, `/api/doctor/crm`, `/api/consulta`.
2. **Authenticated OWNER → everything under `/api/*`**: isolation is **object-level per route handler** (`ownerId` / `userPatientIds` checks) — the primary BOLA surface. `requireAuth` authenticates only; it does NOT scope.
3. **ADMIN → `/api/admin/*`**: `requireAdmin` (role==='ADMIN') applied via `router.use` in `admin.routes.ts`; **other mounts claiming admin scope (e.g. `/api/admin/pharmacies`) must be checked for their own guard**.
4. **Webhook → billing state**: providers' payloads are **not HMAC-signed**; approval trusts (a) pending `Subscription` matching `mpPaymentId`, (b) amount equality, (c) status idempotency. **Billing responses return `paymentId` (= `mpPaymentId`) to the client**, and OpenPix `correlationID` is stored AS `mpPaymentId` — the "secret" match key is client-visible. correlationID format is predictable (`plan_<subId>`, `credits_<subId>_<n>`).
5. **JWT**: `Authorization: Bearer`, 7d expiry, sliding renewal (`X-Renewed-Token`), `tokenVersion` revocation is **tolerant to legacy tokens without `ver` claim** (any token minted without ver bypasses revocation until expiry). `requirePhotoToken` accepts **any** valid token (patient or doctor) for **any** patient photo — CUID non-enumerability is the only barrier (LGPD facial data).

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories
- **BOLA/IDOR (priority 1)**: OWNER A supplies OWNER B's `patientId`/exam/item/analysis/measurement/medication/reminder/vaccine/expense/screening IDs on ~30 route files. Sweep ALL of them; each missing `ownerId` check is its own finding.
- **Webhook spoofing (priority 2)**: create subscription → read `paymentId` from billing response → `POST /api/webhooks/openpix {charge:{correlationID:<paymentId>,status:'COMPLETED'},value:<amount>}` or `/asaas {event:'PAYMENT_RECEIVED',payment:{id,status:'RECEIVED',value}}` → premium/credits without paying. Note: OpenPix branch skips status check when status is empty; Asaas accepts status ∈ RECEIVED set.
- **Admin without role check (priority 3)**: routes mounted under `/api/admin/*` or performing admin actions outside `admin.routes.ts` (pharmacies, settings, push campaigns, tickets, credits) that miss `requireAdmin`.
- **PII in public endpoints (priority 4)**: lead capture, decifre, public API v1, shared exam reports (`/api/public/shared/:token` + 6-digit PIN w/ 10-attempt limiter), doctor CRM lookup, consulta, exam file/photo serving, error messages leaking PII, swagger docs.
- **Raw SQL injection (priority 5)**: `$queryRaw`/`$executeRaw` with interpolated table names/identifiers (see `resetDb`, admin metrics raw queries), `parseListParams` sort/order fields pushed into Prisma `orderBy`, any string-built SQL.
- **Auth weaknesses**: OTP/MFA flows, google sign-in, token renewal semantics, `tokenVersion` legacy tolerance, photo token scope, signup bonus farming, share-PIN brute force.
- **Secrets/supply chain**: `.env` committed, Firebase service-account JSON committed, dependency CVEs (Express 5.2.1, Prisma 6.19.3, sharp 0.32.6, etc.).

## Severity Calibration (this target)
- **Critical**: unauthenticated or single-request cross-patient health-data disclosure at scale; admin takeover; unauthenticated RCE/SQLi.
- **High**: BOLA on any clinical object (LGPD sensitive data); webhook spoofing granting paid plan/credits; PII (CPF/photo/health) leak in public endpoints; hardcoded production credentials.
- **Medium**: BOLA on low-sensitivity objects; auth weaknesses needing preconditions; CORS/session weaknesses.
- **Low**: missing headers, verbose errors, rate-limit gaps, defense-in-depth.

**Non-story**: internal-only tooling, test fixtures' fake data, swagger exposure of public routes, CORS allowlist nits in dev mode.

## Validation Harness (shared)
Dynamic validation runs **in-process via supertest** (`test/helpers.ts`: `resetDb`, `createUser`, `mintToken`, `api()`) against Postgres `127.0.0.1:5433/meus_exames_test` (user `meus_exames`, pass `meus_exames_dev`). Root agent is standing this up; if unavailable, write a standalone vitest file following `test/setup.ts` env+mock pattern. **Never point tests at the dev DB in `.env`.**

amendments.content: **Confirmed instance (PII Leak Auditor, dynamic PoC)**: `POST /api/consulta/exams/:examId` (src/routes/consulta.ts:10-22) fetches the exam by bare `findUnique` with **no ownerId/userPatientIds check** — any authenticated user renders any patient's full clinical prep document (full name, age, clinicalProfile incl. mental-health meds, abnormal values, prior-exam evolution). 200-confirmed cross-patient LGPD leak; fix pattern = same ownership check as `loadOwnedExam`. Also confirmed: `/api/public/shared/:token` renders patient-controlled `fullName`/exam `title` unescaped into the doctor-facing HTML (stored HTML injection, app.ts:455-460) — only `contentMd` is escaped. BOLA agents: consulta.ts is already covered; do not re-derive. Dynamic harness note: vitest hangs in this sandbox (module resolution ~39s/import); working pattern = esbuild-bundle `dist/src/app.js` to /tmp + standalone node script with test-env vars + supertest.
